items.hook: A gunpowder factory explodes in Valletta, Malta, killing 22 people and damaging several buildings.
items.body: On 12 September 1634, a Hospitaller gunpowder factory in Valletta, Malta accidentally blew up, killing 22 people and causing severe damage to a number of buildings. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Typhoon Maemi, the strongest recorded typhoon to strike South Korea, made landfall near Busan.
items.body: Typhoon Maemi, known in the Philippines as Typhoon Pogi, was the most powerful typhoon to strike South Korea since record-keeping began in the country in 1904. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
